WEST – Sibuna Desert
EAST – Spider Lair
This place don't seem so different from the fields back home, does it?
We've got no way of reachin' General Brigard. We've started to 'ave a look at the perimeter, but I'd much rather've been in his regiment, that's for certain.
Hmmm... I can do it, it's not that high.
Better plan your jumps if you don't want to fall down 'ere like me. Takin' a leap right at the last second might just do it.
The drop from these platforms doesn't seem too steep. Shouldn't be hard to climb up and down 'em.
Climbing down, jumpin', blockin'... What's all this then? Some sorta testin' ground?
